name: coupling_holodeck_science_method

pytorch.reason: KL divergence tracks holodeck cycle convergence; entropy gradient tracks science method sharpening

pyg.reason: not needed; no GNN in this sim

z3.reason: UNSAT: holodeck fixed point requires KL=0; KL>0 and fixed_point=True is contradictory

cvc5.reason: not needed; z3 covers fixed-point SMT proof

sympy.reason: symbolic fixed-point analysis: holodeck W=W self-consistent; science method limit -> h* unique survivor

clifford.reason: holodeck = closed Cl(3,0) rotor loop (R*R_inv=scalar 1); science method = open ratchet with monotone norm decrease

geomstats.reason: not needed; rotor loops handled by Clifford algebra

e3nn.reason: not needed; no equivariant network in this sim

rustworkx.reason: rustworkx cycle detection: holodeck is non-DAG (cyclic co-specification); science method is DAG (ratchet)

xgi.reason: 3-way hyperedges encode holodeck mutual-update triple and science-method Popperian triple; reflexivity difference confirmed

toponetx.reason: not needed; cycle structure handled by rustworkx

pytorch_kl_and_sharpness.claim: holodeck KL decreases toward mutual fixed point; science method sharpness gradient nonzero (always updating)

sympy_fixed_point_analysis.claim: holodeck has co-stabilizing fixed point W=W; science method eliminates all but h*

clifford_loop_vs_ratchet.claim: holodeck rotor loop closes (R*R_inv=1); science method ratchet is open (strictly monotone norm decrease)

rustworkx_cycle_vs_dag.claim: holodeck graph has cycle (mutual co-specification); science method graph is acyclic (one-way ratchet)

xgi_holodeck_vs_science_hyperedges.claim: holodeck 3-way hyperedge is reflexive (W->W'); science method triple is irreflexive (pred->update are distinct)

z3_kl_fixedpoint_unsat.claim: UNSAT: KL(post||prior)>0 and cycle at fixed point are mutually exclusive

pytorch_ratchet_irreversible.claim: KL(posterior||prior) > 0 after observation; science method cannot return to prior

sympy_holodeck_balanced_fixed_point.claim: balanced holodeck (W=0.5, balanced likelihood) is a valid fixed point; not an error state

pytorch_kl_zero_at_fixed_point.claim: KL=0 at holodeck fixed point (prior = posterior); boundary condition satisfied

clifford_identity_rotor_boundary.claim: identity rotor (theta=0) trivially closes; boundary condition of holodeck is no-op

rustworkx_trivial_single_node.claim: single-node graph is trivially DAG; degenerate case where holodeck and science method coincide

xgi_empty_hypergraph_no_update.claim: empty hypergraph: no observation triple, no update; both holodeck and science method are frozen

coupling_claim: Holodeck (co-generative mutual cycle, KL->0 fixed point W=W) and Science Method (one-way Popperian ratchet, never returns to prior) are structurally distinct: holodeck graph is cyclic; science method graph is acyclic. Both converge but to different fixed-point types (mutual vs. one-way).
